key_insight: MedCase-Structured provides a synthetic dataset for evaluating clinical decision support systems using structured FHIR data.
clinical_relevance: This dataset allows for improved benchmarking of diagnostic reasoning in real-world clinical settings.
method: Generates HL7 FHIR R4 bundles from unstructured text.
Utilizes staged LLM generation with terminology validation and repair.
Reduces hallucinated codes and enforces data consistency.
evidence_signal: 82.5% of clinician-authored diagnostic cases achieved valid FHIR generation.
watch_item: LLMs show lower diagnostic accuracy with structured FHIR inputs compared to plain text.
paper_title: MedCase-Structured: A Text-to-FHIR Dataset for Benchmarking Diagnostic Reasoning in Clinically Realistic EHR Settings
